## [COMMUNITY-ACQUIRED PNEUMONIA (CAP)](cap-treated-in-outpt-setting)

Empirical regimens listed here cover the usual pathogens associated with CAP, including atypical pathogens. Specific therapy should be guided by culture results.

## Empirical treatment

If a patient has taken an antimicrobial in the previous 3 months, it is prudent to avoid giving the same or a similar drug for the current episode of pneumonia.
